answer: Require each new agent to keep a small stake in an escrow orchard that only ripens after it signs work receipts countersigned by already-trusted peers over a 30-day window. Think of every receipt as a quill stroke on a shared ledger: forging hundreds of fake identities means locking hundreds of stakes and earning genuine countersignatures for each, so a sybil swarm's costs climb toward a zenith long before its fake reputation pays off.
